scripts/backfill-level-ids.mjs.note: One-time permanent published-level ID backfill; retained for provenance and reproducibility.

scripts/backfill-level-provenance.mjs.note: Completed provenance backfill; its published-level fallback depends on a retired classifier report.

scripts/audit-family-boundary-inputs.mjs.note: Checks whether historical/tracked family evidence has enough identity and provenance for boundary analysis.

scripts/audit-family-result-identity.mjs.note: Diagnoses ambiguous or unmatched family-result identity before migration or namespacing.

scripts/audit-technique-census-duplicate.note: Diagnoses duplicate cells in a specific technique-census artifact; not a standard census entry point.

scripts/stress/axis-reach-probe.mjs.note: Axis-aware connectivity candidate was implemented and reverted twice after matched-budget regressions; retain as reproducible negative evidence/template, not a live optimization direction.

scripts/stress/main-loop-starvation-cens.note: Reproduces the August 8 main-loop zero-allocation census from historical baseline/hint provenance. Its report later weakened 'provably recoverable' to 'historically matched', and newer techniqueLifecycle telemetry is the default allocation diagnostic.

scripts/stress/winning-path-archaeology..note: Early local-child-rank proxy retained for reproducibility; current winning-lineage instrumentation and methodology supersede it for lineage-survival research.

scripts/stress/turnbias-churn-check.mjs.note: Scratch local churn check for the historical repair-turn-bias experiment; its own header points to deterministic GitHub Actions sweeps for authoritative evidence.
